en.shortDescription: Open-source backend for realtime apps and IoT
en.longDescription:
Kuzzle is a generic backend with REST, WebSocket, and MQTT APIs backed by Elasticsearch and Redis.

API on port 7512. Includes Elasticsearch for document storage and Redis for caching.
